finding: Canonical strings differ by engine, but schematic output is RDKit-parseable and has the same canonical RDKit structure as the input.
scope: semantic V3000 topology probe; exact canonical-string parity and SGROUP cross-engine semantics remain open

reproduction.chematic: cargo run -p chematic-cli --locked --offline -- convert --input-format mol_v3000 --output-format smiles --input benchmarks/fixtures/ethanol.v3000
reproduction.rdkit: python3 -c "from rdkit import Chem; m=Chem.MolFromMolFile('benchmarks/fixtures/ethanol.v3000', removeHs=False); print(Chem.MolToSmiles(m, canonical=True, isomericSmiles=True))"
